description: Fixed comparison recipe for issue #5 / PR #8: does sensor-attribute preservation change any detector decision across the complete nine-bag panel? Streams both runs, records every material mismatch, validates ingestion against the saved read-only SQLite inventory and binds source identity to declared revisions.
hypothesis: Sensor-attribute preservation is behavior-neutral across complete real recordings, not only no-obstacle prefixes.
tolerance_scope: Absolute/relative tolerance applies only to continuous floating estimates. Identifiers, counters, booleans, list lengths, dict keys and source/evidence timestamps compare exactly. No tolerance is applied to timestamps.
excluded_note: Only these operational timing fields plus the top-level sensor_attributes summary are excluded. Timing, throughput and RSS are reported, never used to assert a detector decision, field latency or recall. The sensor_attributes summary must remain present with unknown flags and availability counts in strict mode; it carries no detector-promotion flag.
provenance_note: Manifest git_revision is reported exactly as captured and is NOT the implementation revision: the baseline ran from an archived bc4f73b snapshot nested inside the fix worktree, so run.git_revision() there reports the enclosing branch. Source identity is the captured source_sha256 hashes bound in results/issue-5-regression-source-20260922.json to the declared revisions. Native kernel source hashes are compared; compiled binary hashes are retained as evidence and are not required to be equal.
panel: Fixed nine-bag panel of the two issue-5 replay configs: every=1, max_frames=null, EOF, seed 20260915, detector-native.json, odometry_threads 8.
